mission_05: Excellent! You have implemented MICE, the most sophisticated imputation technique in the standard toolkit. By iteratively modeling each incomplete variable as a function of all others, MICE captures complex multivariate relationships that simpler methods cannot. You explored different underlying estimators, observing how BayesianRidge excels with linear relationships while RandomForest handles non-linear patterns. The iterative nature of MICE means imputations improve with each round, converging to values consistent with the joint data distribution. This technique is the gold standard for handling Missing at Random (MAR) data and is widely used in clinical research, social sciences, and any domain where data quality is paramount.
